messages:
maria: Heads-up  I'm landing a compact refresh to the Quickstart: replace curl with an SDK example, normalize env var names, and fix a bad anchor. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4138.

jamal: Nice. can you drop the node snippet here so i can sanity-check the auth flow?

maria: pasted below, tiny and async-friendly:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-rt-1', prompt: 'Hello from Quickstart' });
console.log(out.text);
```

tom: looks concise. make sure the docker run example uses the same env var name (users copy-paste that).

maria: yes  swapped all `REDSYS_TOKEN` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in page + dockerfile + CI snippets. added a short note about not committing envs.

elyse: FYI our example container moved to `redwood/hello:2026-03`. can you update the Deploy section to that tag? saves confusion later.

maria: updated in branch. left a tiny TODO about ephemeral key guidance.

jamal: should we add a 2-line migration note for SDK3 -> SDK4 (ctor vs setApiKey)? some users still land on older snippets.

maria: good call. i added a Migration section linking to /sdk/migrate and an explicit example: `new Redwood({ apiKey })` vs old `client.setApiKey(...)`.

docs-bot: ci:docs  linkcheck passed, lint passed.

tom: i'm taking reviewer duties. i'll run through the CLI and Deploy steps locally.

maria: thanks! i also fixed the broken anchor that was pointing to a removed heading.

tom: one minor nit: in the snippet prefer `await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-rt-1', input: '...' })` to match API shape in our current SDK. i'll push a one-line tweak.

maria: cool, merge after your review+CI. tagging @docs-bot for staging publish.

docs-bot: publish:docs scheduled  staging will pick up the change in ~8m.
